# Clip Studio TIPS

> A community-driven platform sharing digital art tutorials and creative techniques for Clip Studio Paint users of all skill levels.

Clip Studio TIPS aggregates official tutorials and community-contributed guides covering digital illustration, character design, painting techniques, and tool mastery. The platform features both beginner fundamentals and advanced artistic methods from experienced creators.

## Key Topics

- Clip Studio Paint
- Digital illustration
- Character design
- Drawing techniques
- Brush creation
- Layer management
- 3D models
- Lighting and shading
- Anatomy and hand drawing
- Color filling
- Line art
- Material rendering
- Digital painting
- Community tips
- Art education

## Official Tutorials & Features

- [CLIP STUDIO PAINT Official Tutorials](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/official): Official Clip Studio Paint tutorials for beginners to experts with text and video content
- [3D hand model to help you pose expressive hands! -Ver.5.0-](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/11932): Official guide to using 3D hand models in Clip Studio Paint version 5.0 and newer

## Character Art & Anatomy

- [Hand Gestures and Simplifying the Hand! "Anatomy How to Draw by Leriisa #1"](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/3251): Leriisa's tutorial on hand anatomy, gestures, and simplification techniques
- [Draw Pretty EYES in 3 EASY Steps](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/10220): Neko-Rina's beginner-friendly guide to drawing expressive anime-style eyes
- [Head & Face Accessories Tutorial](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/12142): AtomAutonom's guide to designing and rendering head and face accessories
- [How to sketch and paint side-profiles](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/11966): Cabanek's tutorial on drawing and painting side-profile portrait techniques
- [Fashion Coordination and Character Design Reference Materials Utilizing Layer Comps](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/10925): Guide to using Layer Comps for fashion design and character variations in Clip Studio Paint

## Painting & Rendering Techniques

- [How To Create Dramatic Lighting "Light Expression #1"](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/6396): Soliloquince's guide to dramatic lighting effects and character shading techniques
- [Simple Backlit Character Illustration](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/10973): CHYEE's tutorial on backlit character illustration and lighting composition
- [How to Draw GOLD, METALS, GEMS and PEARLS for Accessories](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/12114): .avi.'s tutorial on rendering metallic materials, gems, and jewelry accessories
- [Let's Create a Colored Pencils Illustration In CSP](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/10929): Cherrzart's tutorial on creating traditional-style colored pencil illustrations digitally
- [How to draw like real graphite pencil with digital brushes](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/10967): MichaelGuimont's guide to simulating realistic graphite pencil with digital brushes

## Tools & Techniques

- [Textured brushes from scratch](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/3320): Tutorial by Marredae on creating custom textured brushes in Clip Studio Paint
- [Fill Base Colors Fast and Easy](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/6283): Neko-Rina's guide to efficient base color filling using fill tools in Clip Studio Paint
- [Drawing Perfect Lines for Beginners](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/8712): Luckyqilin's beginner guide to lineart fundamentals and line confidence
- [How to Make a Digital "Linocut"](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/12104): Ilbraman's guide to creating digital linocut artwork using Clip Studio Paint

## Background & Environment Art

- [How to draw unrealistic Street](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/articles/12125): DrownInNoodles' tutorial on stylized street background and building architecture

## Community & Events

- [Results of the 81st Clip Studio Paint Tips of the Month](https://tips.clip-studio.com/en-us/tips-of-the-month): Monthly contest results and winners for Clip Studio Paint tips submissions
